verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. The default MCP resources and prompts capabilities are wired through the real JSON-RPC dispatch; graph reads preserve default/named-graph isolation, reserved-URI behavior, budgeted materialization, and distinct not-found versus internal-error handling. Prompt IRI interpolation validates with oxrdf::NamedNode before rendering and rejects hostile or missing inputs. The end-to-end tests exercise the real dispatch, capability advertisement, protocol error codes, graph isolation, prompt rendering/refusal, and read-only behavior. Public documentation and dependency/feature declarations match the implementation. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found.
